title: Phi-4 Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计合成数据、SFT 与 DPO 披露边界的读者
one_line: Phi-4 releases MIT model weights and reports a 9.8T-token synthetic-heavy pipeline, 8B-token SFT, 250,297 token-local DPO examples, and about 850K judge-guided pairs, but no training corpus or stage-to-record lineage.
Phi-4 报告了以合成数据为主的预训练与后训练：约 50 类数据集、约 400B 合成 token、8B SFT token，以及由任务 oracle 辅助的 DPO；但未发布数据、完整血缘或 verifier 细节。
why: It lets frontier-report readers separate report-level data disclosure, released weights, unavailable training records, mixed verifier and judge contracts, and downstream benchmark behavior instead of treating them as one evidence claim.
inclusion_reason: Phi-4 is a high-value frontier disclosure because it reports synthetic-data source scale, organic-seed filtering, a 9.8T-token training run, 8B-token SFT, token-local oracle-assisted DPO, and full-length judge-guided DPO while releasing weights but not training data or lineage.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary sources are Microsoft Research Technical Report MSR-TR-2024-57, arXiv:2412.08905, the official microsoft/phi-4 model repository, and its later official data summary. Microsoft identifies 27 authors and published the report in December 2024. The Hugging Face repository verifies a downloadable MIT-licensed checkpoint; it is not a training-data release.

The report asks how a 14B dense model can gain reasoning, coding, and instruction-following capability through data construction and curriculum rather than a major architecture change. Phi-4 uses synthetic data throughout pretraining and post-training, while filtered organic data supplies both direct training material and seeds for synthetic generation.

For this atlas, the audit problem is to keep four ledgers separate: what the report says about data, what model weights are downloadable, what training records and generation decisions are downloadable, and what evaluation says about model behavior. Phi-4 has substantial evidence in the first two ledgers, no official corpus in the third, and extensive benchmark evidence in the fourth. Scores cannot fill missing source, license, lineage, or verifier fields.

The disclosed data objects span several scales. The model card reports a 9.8T-token training run. The report describes about 50 broad synthetic dataset types totaling about 400B unweighted source tokens, around 8B SFT tokens, 250,297 first-round Pivotal Token Search examples, and 841,842 second-round judge-guided DPO pairs. These are report-level aggregates without released row schemas or a crosswalk into the final model. That makes Phi-4 a strong frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger entry, while its partial status and L4 level must remain.

本卡的一手来源包括Microsoft Research技术报告MSR-TR-2024-57、arXiv:2412.08905、官方microsoft/phi-4模型仓库及其后续官方data summary。微软列出27位作者，并于2024年12月发布报告。Hugging Face仓库可核验MIT许可证权重可下载，但它不是训练数据发布。

报告研究的问题是：如何在没有大幅修改架构的情况下，通过数据构造和课程让14B dense模型获得推理、代码与指令遵循能力。Phi-4在预训练和后训练中持续使用合成数据，同时让过滤后的organic数据既作为直接训练材料，也作为合成生成种子。

对本atlas而言，审计重点是分开四本账：报告对数据披露了什么、模型权重是否可下载、训练记录与生成决策是否可下载，以及评测说明了何种模型行为。Phi-4在前两本账中证据较强，第三本账没有官方语料，第四本账有大量benchmark证据。分数不能补齐来源、许可证、lineage或verifier字段。

已披露数据对象横跨多个规模。模型卡报告9.8T-token训练运行；报告描述约50类广义合成数据集，共约400B未加权源token，约8B SFT token，第一轮250,297条Pivotal Token Search示例，以及第二轮841,842个judge-guided DPO pair。这些都是报告级聚合量，没有公开行模式，也没有到最终模型的对照表。因此Phi-4适合作为frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger条目，但必须保留partial状态与L4级别。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Phi-4's data strategy combines curriculum allocation with synthetic transformation. Organic web, academic, book, code, and Q&A material is filtered for educational or reasoning value. Some records enter the mixture directly; others become seeds for exercises, discussions, Q&A pairs, code instructions, or structured reasoning documents through multi-stage generation, rewriting, self-revision, and instruction reversal.

The 400B figure is the approximate unweighted size of about 50 synthetic source families, not the final training-token count. The released model card reports 9.8T training tokens and a 16K context window, but neither source publishes the final per-family weights, repetition counts, or unique-record inventory. The report's mixture search varies synthetic, web-rewrite, filtered-web, targeted-acquisition, organic, and code allocations through smaller ablations before transferring the chosen recipe to phi-4.

Post-training has three distinct supervision objects. SFT uses about 8B chat-formatted tokens from math, code, reasoning, conversation, model-identity, safety, and 40-language multilingual data; multiple responses are generated and an LLM-based evaluator selects the best. First-round DPO uses Pivotal Token Search to estimate how individual token choices change oracle-checked completion success and constructs token-local preference pairs. Second-round DPO forms full-response pairs from GPT-4o, GPT-4t, and phi-4 generations, then uses GPT-4o to score accuracy, style, and detail.

The feedback contract is therefore mixed, not a single quality label. Code tests and mathematical answer comparison are programmatic outcome checks for some Pivotal Token Search tasks. GPT-4o is a judgment-based pair selector in the second round. The SFT evaluator is described only at role level. No released record carries the generator, score, oracle result, acceptance decision, or final stage membership.

Phi-4的数据策略把课程分配与合成转换结合起来。organic网页、学术材料、书籍、代码和问答内容先按教育价值或推理价值筛选；部分记录直接进入训练混合，其他记录则通过多阶段生成、改写、自我修订和指令反转，转化为练习、讨论、问答对、代码指令或结构化推理文档。

400B表示约50个合成源家族的未加权近似规模，而不是最终训练token数。公开模型卡报告9.8T训练token和16K context window，但两项来源都没有发布各家族最终权重、重复次数或唯一记录清单。报告先在较小消融中改变synthetic、web rewrite、filtered web、targeted acquisition、organic和code的分配，再把选择后的配方迁移到phi-4。

后训练有三种不同监督对象。SFT使用约8B chat格式token，覆盖数学、代码、推理、对话、模型身份、安全及40种语言；先生成多个回答，再由LLM-based evaluator选优。第一轮DPO使用Pivotal Token Search估计单个token选择如何改变oracle检查后的completion成功率，并构造token-local preference pair。第二轮DPO从GPT-4o、GPT-4t和phi-4回答形成完整回答pair，再由GPT-4o按准确性、风格和细节评分。

因此反馈契约是mixed，而不是统一质量标签。代码测试和数学答案比较只是在部分Pivotal Token Search任务上的程序化结果检查；GPT-4o是第二轮的判断型pair selector；SFT evaluator只披露了角色。没有公开记录保存generator、分数、oracle结果、接受决策或最终训练阶段归属。

title: Method
方法
html:
Organic-data preparation starts with targeted acquisitions and filtered bulk sources. The report names academic papers, educational forums, programming tutorials, licensed books, arXiv, PubMed Central, GitHub, CommonCrawl, and Wikipedia as examples, but does not publish a complete source inventory. Web dumps are ranked with small classifiers trained on LLM annotations; multilingual documents use fastText language identification and similar quality filters. Custom parsers ingest HTML, TeX, ePub/XML-like files, Word documents, and PDFs.

Synthetic construction begins from curated seeds. Roughly 50 dataset families use different multi-stage procedures. Techniques include rewriting passages into exercises and discussions, extracting deduction chains as Q&A pairs, iterative self-revision against reasoning and factuality rubrics, and instruction reversal that derives a task description from existing code. Question pools are filtered by generating multiple answers: unanimous agreement is treated as too easy, complete inconsistency as too hard or ambiguous, and plurality answers may replace unavailable ground truth for rejection sampling. Code and some scientific records can be checked with execution loops or tests.

The final pretraining/midtraining run is reported as 9.8T tokens. The report's about-400B figure refers to unweighted synthetic source tokens; final allocation, unique-document count, epoch/repetition accounting, and exact source proportions are unknown. Midtraining extends context to 16K. The official model card reports 1,920 H100-80G GPUs and 21 days, but generation and filtering compute are not separated.

SFT uses one round and about 8B chat-formatted tokens across math, code, reasoning, conversation, model identity, safety, and 40 languages. Prompts mix public instruction data and synthetic prompts; multiple responses are generated and selected by LLM evaluation. The evaluator checkpoint, prompts, candidate count, score distribution, threshold, accepted-record count, and exact SFT mixture are unknown.

Pivotal Token Search recursively examines a completion by estimating oracle-checked success probabilities from sampled continuations before and after segments. It subdivides by cumulative token log-probability and turns a token that sharply increases or decreases success into a single-token accepted/rejected pair. Code can use a comprehensive test suite; math can compare the final answer with ground truth. The search is not guaranteed to find all pivotal tokens unless success probability is near-monotone. Rollout counts, thresholds, memoized estimates, and oracle implementations are not released.

Table 7 contains 250,297 first-round examples: 132,859 generic multiple-choice Q&A, 76,552 math, 16,080 Python, 21,806 C++/Go/Java/JavaScript/Rust, and 3,000 additional safety or hallucination-related examples. The second round generates responses from GPT-4o, GPT-4t, and phi-4; GPT-4o judges pairs by accuracy and by an aggregate of accuracy, style, and detail. Table 8 totals 841,842 pairs, while the prose rounds this to about 850K. Both rounds mix a small amount of safety and hallucination-mitigation data.

organic数据准备从targeted acquisition和大规模来源过滤开始。报告举例列出学术论文、教育论坛、编程教程、licensed book、arXiv、PubMed Central、GitHub、CommonCrawl和Wikipedia，但没有发布完整来源清单。web dump由使用LLM annotation训练的小型classifier排序；多语言文档使用fastText语言识别和类似质量过滤；定制parser处理HTML、TeX、ePub/XML类文件、Word文档和PDF。

合成构造从筛选后的种子开始。约50个数据家族采用不同多阶段流程，包括把段落改写为练习和讨论、把推导链抽取为问答对、依据推理与事实rubric迭代自我修订，以及从已有代码反向生成任务描述的instruction reversal。问题池通过多次生成答案来过滤：完全一致视为过易，完全不一致视为过难或含糊；缺少真值时，plurality answer可替代ground truth用于拒绝采样。代码和部分科学记录可以用execution loop或test检查。

最终预训练与midtraining运行报告为9.8T token；约400B表示未加权合成源token。最终分配、唯一文档数、epoch或重复记账及精确来源比例均为unknown。midtraining把context扩展到16K。官方模型卡报告使用1,920张H100-80G、训练21天，但没有分开生成与过滤计算量。

SFT进行一轮，使用约8B chat格式token，覆盖数学、代码、推理、对话、模型身份、安全和40种语言。提示混合公开instruction数据与synthetic prompt；先生成多个回答，再由LLM评估选优。evaluator checkpoint、提示、候选数量、分数分布、阈值、接受记录数和精确SFT mixture均为unknown。

Pivotal Token Search通过比较片段前后采样continuation的oracle成功率，递归检查一个completion；它按累计token log-probability划分片段，再把显著提高或降低成功率的单个token转为接受/拒绝pair。代码可使用完整test suite，数学可把最终答案与ground truth比较。除非成功率沿解答过程近似单调，否则该搜索不能保证找到全部pivotal token。rollout数量、阈值、memoized estimate与oracle实现均未发布。

表7包含250,297条第一轮示例：132,859条通用选择问答、76,552条数学、16,080条Python、21,806条C++/Go/Java/JavaScript/Rust，以及3,000条额外安全或幻觉缓解示例。第二轮由GPT-4o、GPT-4t和phi-4生成回答，GPT-4o按准确性以及准确性、风格、细节的聚合评分判断pair。表8合计841,842个pair，正文将其约写为850K；两轮都混入少量安全与幻觉缓解数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest artifact evidence is the official model repository. It is labeled MIT, totals about 29.3 GB, and exposes six BF16 safetensor shards plus configuration, tokenizer, generation, license, model-card, and data-summary files. This verifies that the phi-4 checkpoint is downloadable. It does not verify a training-data release, because no corpus files, SFT rows, DPO pairs, candidate responses, or verifier logs are present.

The official model card reports a 14B dense decoder-only model, 16K context, 9.8T training tokens, 1,920 H100-80G GPUs, 21 training days, a June 2024 cutoff for public data, and about 8% multilingual data. The later official data summary confirms public sources, commercial licensing agreements, acquired data, synthetic data, cleaning, and a 30 June 2024 latest collection date. It does not enumerate sources or records and says some other third-party information cannot be provided because underlying data are unavailable.

The report provides unusually concrete construction counts. About 50 synthetic families total roughly 400B unweighted source tokens; SFT consumes about 8B tokens; first-round Pivotal Token Search DPO has 250,297 examples; second-round judge-guided DPO has 841,842 pairs and is described as approximately 850K. These figures establish report-level scale, not unique record count, released-row count, or a complete lineage into the 9.8T-token run.

Post-training ablations separate model behavior after SFT, Pivotal Token Search DPO, second-round-only DPO, and both DPO rounds. For example, the report lists GPQA as 47.3 after SFT, 53.6 after first-round DPO, 52.4 after second-round-only DPO, and 56.1 after both; MATH is 77.1, 80.5, 77.6, and 80.4. These comparisons support the reported optimizer sequence under its evaluation setup. They do not certify the correctness, rights, diversity, or contamination status of training records.

Fresh November 2024 AMC evaluation occurs after the June 2024 collection cutoff and is useful model evidence against direct exposure to those particular contests. The report nevertheless acknowledges that n-gram decontamination can miss rephrased overlap. A fresh benchmark cannot replace a released corpus-level match and removal ledger.

The report itself identifies weaknesses: SimpleQA, DROP, and IFEval are weak relative to several comparisons, and strict instruction following was not a focus of the synthetic generation. These results are evidence about model behavior and recipe tradeoffs, not evidence that more synthetic data or higher scores automatically means higher data quality.

最强artifact证据来自官方模型仓库。它标为MIT，总量约29.3 GB，公开6个BF16 safetensor shard，以及配置、tokenizer、generation、license、model card和data summary文件。这能核验phi-4 checkpoint可下载，但不能核验训练数据发布，因为其中没有语料文件、SFT记录、DPO pair、候选回答或verifier日志。

官方模型卡报告14B dense decoder-only模型、16K context、9.8T训练token、1,920张H100-80G、21天训练、公开数据截至2024年6月，以及约8%多语言数据。后续官方data summary确认使用公开来源、商业许可协议、购得数据、合成数据和清洗流程，最新收集日期为2024年6月30日；但它不枚举来源或记录，并说明部分其他第三方信息因底层数据不可用而无法提供。

报告给出较具体的构造数量：约50个合成家族共约400B未加权源token，SFT使用约8B token，第一轮Pivotal Token Search DPO有250,297条示例，第二轮judge-guided DPO有841,842个pair，正文约写为850K。这些数字确立报告级规模，不等于唯一记录数、发布行数或进入9.8T-token训练的完整lineage。

后训练消融分别报告SFT后、Pivotal Token Search DPO后、只做第二轮DPO以及两轮DPO后的模型行为。例如GPQA依次为47.3、53.6、52.4和56.1，MATH依次为77.1、80.5、77.6和80.4。这些比较支持报告评测设置下的optimizer顺序，却不能认证训练记录的正确性、权利、多样性或污染状态。

2024年11月AMC评测晚于2024年6月收集截止，对排除模型直接接触这些特定竞赛题是有用的模型证据。不过，报告也承认n-gram去污染可能漏掉改写重叠。新鲜benchmark不能替代公开的全语料匹配与移除ledger。

报告自身也指出弱项：相较多项对照，SimpleQA、DROP和IFEval表现较弱，严格指令遵循并非合成生成重点。这些结果说明模型行为与配方取舍，不能证明更多合成数据或更高分数自动代表更高数据质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is the earlier Phi strategy of teacher distillation plus synthetic textbook-like data, conventional filtered web/code pretraining, rejection-sampled SFT, and full-response DPO. Phi-4 changes the emphasis by using synthetic data throughout pretraining and post-training, searching the curriculum mixture, and converting oracle-estimated local success changes into token-level preference pairs.

At the construction level, the report's contribution is a portfolio rather than one generator. Seed curation, web rewriting, Q&A extraction, self-revision, instruction reversal, execution-backed code validation, and plurality filtering are assigned to different data families. The report also documents why a synthetic-only ablation loses factual recall, motivating a mixed organic/synthetic recipe rather than claiming synthetic data replaces organic knowledge sources.

Pivotal Token Search is the most specific post-training novelty. Standard DPO on divergent full responses spreads preference signal across many tokens. Pivotal Token Search samples continuations around prefixes, invokes an outcome oracle, recursively isolates token choices with a large success-probability change, and trains on a pair differing at that local choice. This creates automated token-local preference supervision without training a separate process reward model.

What is not new must remain explicit: SFT, DPO, synthetic generation, self-revision, majority voting, code tests, answer checking, curriculum search, and LLM judging all predate this report. Nor does Pivotal Token Search establish step-wise mathematical truth; its signal is the estimated effect of a token on final oracle success under sampled continuations.

For frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, the novelty is also the disclosure combination: source classes, aggregate token scales, three post-training objects, pair counts, oracle roles, a released weight artifact, and benchmark caveats appear in one official report. The pipeline is still not open because data, prompts, per-record decisions, and replay assets are absent.

既有基线包括早期Phi的教师蒸馏与合成textbook-like数据、常规过滤网页/代码预训练、拒绝采样SFT及完整回答DPO。Phi-4的变化是把合成数据贯穿预训练与后训练，搜索课程mixture，并把oracle估计的局部成功率变化转化为token-level preference pair。

在构造层面，报告贡献是一组方法组合，而不是单一generator。种子筛选、web rewrite、问答抽取、自我修订、instruction reversal、执行支持的代码验证和plurality filtering分别用于不同数据家族。报告还说明synthetic-only消融会损害事实召回，因此选择organic/synthetic混合，而不是声称合成数据可替代organic知识来源。

Pivotal Token Search是最具体的后训练新意。标准DPO在差异较大的完整回答上把preference信号分散到许多token；Pivotal Token Search则在prefix附近采样continuation，调用结果oracle，递归定位造成较大成功率变化的token选择，并用只在该局部选择上不同的pair训练。这样无需另训process reward model，也能生成自动化token-local preference监督。

必须明确哪些并非新贡献：SFT、DPO、合成生成、自我修订、多数投票、代码测试、答案检查、课程搜索和LLM judging都早于该报告。Pivotal Token Search也不能确立逐步数学真值；其信号是采样continuation下某个token对最终oracle成功率的估计影响。

对frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger而言，披露组合也值得关注：来源类别、聚合token规模、三类后训练对象、pair数量、oracle角色、公开权重artifact和benchmark警告出现在同一官方报告中。但由于数据、提示、逐记录决策和重放资产缺失，该流程仍不是开放配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No training corpus is released. The model repository contains weights and metadata, not pretraining documents, synthetic records, SFT conversations, Pivotal Token Search pairs, judge-guided pairs, safety records, candidates, verifier outputs, or rejection decisions.
  • The 400B figure counts unweighted synthetic source tokens, while 9.8T is the reported final training-token budget. Final source weights, repetitions, unique records, stage allocations, and a crosswalk between these quantities are unknown.
  • The report names source classes and examples but not a complete source inventory, revisions, record IDs, proportions, attribution, or license matrix. The later data summary confirms commercial and other third-party data while leaving some underlying detail unavailable.
  • Most synthetic generator and SFT evaluator identities, prompts, decoding settings, seeds, candidate counts, thresholds, acceptance rates, and compute are unknown. “LLM-based evaluation” is not a replayable selection contract.
  • Pivotal Token Search depends on noisy success-probability estimates from sampled continuations. The binary search may miss pivotal tokens when success is not near-monotone, and the rollout count, thresholds, variance, memoization state, and failure audit are not released.
  • Task oracles are partial. Code tests and mathematical final-answer comparison can establish an endpoint under one checker, but do not validate each reasoning step, factual explanation, safety response, or domain without an oracle.
  • GPT-4o creates labels for the second DPO round using accuracy, style, and detail. Judge ordering, raw scores, disagreements, calibration, style/verbosity effects, false accepts, and rejected pairs are unavailable.
  • Decontamination uses 13-gram and 7-gram methods, but the report concedes that rephrased overlap may survive. Exact thresholds are not reliably available in the public HTML, and no benchmark-revision, match, or removal ledger is released.
  • November 2024 AMC is fresh relative to the June 2024 collection cutoff, but it tests model behavior on four contests; it cannot prove that other evaluations or the training mixture are uncontaminated.
  • Model weights use MIT and the manuscript uses CC BY 4.0. Those licenses do not grant rights to unreleased public, acquired, licensed, or synthetic training records; record-level rights and generated-output terms remain unknown.
  • The official model repository evolves after release. Reusers should pin a revision because tokenizer or generation metadata can change independently of the original training run.
  • Benchmark gains, hardware scale, and data volume are model-development evidence. They do not prove corpus quality, provenance, diversity, verifier accuracy, safety completeness, or legal compatibility.

• 没有发布训练语料。模型仓库包含权重与元数据，不包含预训练文档、合成记录、SFT对话、Pivotal Token Search pair、judge-guided pair、安全记录、候选、verifier输出或拒绝决策。
  • 400B表示未加权合成源token，9.8T表示报告中的最终训练token预算。最终来源权重、重复次数、唯一记录、阶段分配和两者对照均为unknown。
  • 报告列出来源类别与示例，但没有完整来源清单、版本、记录ID、比例、署名或许可证矩阵。后续data summary确认商业及其他第三方数据，同时部分底层细节不可用。
  • 大多数合成generator与SFT evaluator的身份、提示、解码设置、seed、候选数、阈值、接受率和计算量均为unknown。“LLM-based evaluation”不是可重放选择契约。
  • Pivotal Token Search依赖采样continuation得到的含噪成功率估计。若成功率不近似单调，binary search可能漏掉pivotal token；rollout数量、阈值、方差、memoization状态和失败审计均未发布。
  • 任务oracle只覆盖部分场景。代码测试和数学最终答案比较可在某个checker下确认终点，但不能验证每一步推理、事实解释、安全回答或没有oracle的领域。
  • 第二轮DPO由GPT-4o按准确性、风格和细节生成标签。judge顺序、原始分数、分歧、校准、风格或verbosity效应、误接受和拒绝pair均不可得。
  • 去污染使用13-gram与7-gram方法，但报告承认改写重叠可能存活。公开HTML无法可靠恢复精确阈值，也没有benchmark版本、匹配或移除ledger。
  • 2024年11月AMC相对2024年6月收集截止是fresh评测，但它只测试4场竞赛上的模型行为，不能证明其他评测或训练mixture无污染。
  • 模型权重使用MIT，手稿使用CC BY 4.0。这些许可证不授予未发布公开、购得、许可或合成训练记录的权利；逐记录权利与生成输出条款仍为unknown。
  • 官方模型仓库在发布后继续演化。复用者应固定revision，因为tokenizer或generation元数据可能独立于原始训练运行发生变化。
  • benchmark提升、硬件规模和数据量属于模型开发证据，不能证明语料质量、provenance、多样性、verifier准确性、安全完整性或法律兼容性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, Phi-4 is useful precisely because it combines strong report detail with a weight-only artifact boundary. Readers can verify the official report, 14B checkpoint, MIT license, six safetensor shards, model card, and later data summary. They cannot inspect the training records. This makes the difference between “documented,” “released,” and “replayable” concrete.

A disclosure ledger should record each layer separately. For pretraining, capture source class, named source, revision, rights, collection date, unique records, tokenization, mixture weight, repetitions, direct-use versus seed-use, synthetic generator, and final run membership. For SFT, add rendered conversation, candidate IDs, generator and evaluator revisions, raw scores, selection threshold, rejection reason, and token count. For DPO, preserve prompt, both responses or token alternatives, oracle/judge inputs and outputs, pair rationale, ordering, score components, and stage membership.

Pivotal Token Search is reusable as a research design when a reliable task oracle and sufficient rollout budget exist. A reproduction should first validate oracle false accepts, estimate success-probability variance, test whether near-monotonicity holds, compare found tokens with exhaustive search on small cases, and publish missed-token and rejected-pair statistics. It should not generalize endpoint verification to domains lacking executable or answer-key checks.

The report also offers useful negative controls. Synthetic-only mixtures underperform on factual recall, strict instruction following remains a weakness, and n-gram decontamination cannot resolve every paraphrase. These observations motivate mixed source portfolios, targeted instruction data, and semantic overlap audits rather than using model scores as a blanket endorsement of the corpus.

Auditors should pin the model revision, verify weight and license files, distinguish the 400B unweighted source pool from the 9.8T training budget, independently sum both DPO tables, and mark every undisclosed generator, threshold, rollout budget, source right, and record count as unknown. The result is a comparable frontier disclosure, not a reconstructed open recipe.

对frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger而言，Phi-4的价值恰恰在于报告细节较强，但artifact边界仍是权重发布。读者可以核验官方报告、14B checkpoint、MIT许可证、6个safetensor shard、model card和后续data summary，却无法检查训练记录。这使“有文档”“已发布”和“可重放”的差别非常具体。

披露ledger应逐层记录。预训练层要保存来源类别、具名来源、版本、权利、收集日期、唯一记录数、tokenization、mixture weight、重复次数、直接使用还是种子使用、synthetic generator以及最终run归属；SFT层要增加渲染后对话、候选ID、generator与evaluator版本、原始分数、选择阈值、拒绝原因和token数；DPO层应保留提示、两个完整回答或token alternative、oracle/judge输入输出、pair理由、顺序、分数组成与阶段归属。

当存在可靠任务oracle与足够rollout预算时，Pivotal Token Search可作为研究设计复用。复现前应验证oracle误接受，估计成功率方差，测试近似单调假设，在小案例上与穷举搜索对比，并发布漏检token和拒绝pair统计。不能把终点验证推广到缺少可执行检查或answer key的领域。

报告也提供有用负面对照：synthetic-only mixture损害事实召回，严格指令遵循仍是弱项，n-gram去污染无法解决全部改写。这些观察支持混合来源组合、针对性instruction数据和语义重叠审计，而不是用模型分数为整个语料背书。

审计者应固定模型revision，核验权重和license文件，区分400B未加权源池与9.8T训练预算，独立加总两张DPO表，并把所有未披露generator、阈值、rollout预算、来源权利与记录数标为unknown。最终得到的是可比较的前沿披露，而不是重建出的开放配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep report disclosures, released MIT weights, unreleased training records, and benchmark behavior in four separate ledgers.
  • Read about 400B as unweighted synthetic source tokens and 9.8T as the final training-token budget; no public crosswalk reconciles them.
  • Post-training has three objects: about 8B SFT tokens, 250,297 token-local Pivotal Token Search examples, and 841,842 full-response judge-guided pairs.
  • Pivotal Token Search uses sampled continuation success plus task oracles; GPT-4o judging is a different contract based on accuracy, style, and detail.
  • Fresh AMC results and n-gram filtering do not replace a released semantic contamination and removal ledger.
  • Preserve generator identities, prompts, rollouts, source rights, record counts, selection decisions, and stage lineage as unknown where undisclosed.

• 分开维护四本账：报告披露、已发布MIT权重、未发布训练记录和benchmark模型行为。
  • 约400B指未加权合成源token，9.8T指最终训练token预算；没有公开对照表连接两者。
  • 后训练有三种对象：约8B SFT token、250,297条token-local Pivotal Token Search示例和841,842个完整回答judge-guided pair。
  • Pivotal Token Search使用采样continuation成功率与任务oracle；GPT-4o judging是按准确性、风格和细节运行的另一契约。
